# ECO-EXT-AUDIT — Ecosystem extension catalog adoption audit

Research finding 2 (high confidence, 3-0) plus openQuestion 1: the ecosystem ships a named extension catalog (AshPostgres, AshSqlite, AshCsv, AshCubDB, AshAuthentication, AshOban, AshStateMachine, AshPaperTrail, AshArchival, AshCloak, AshAi, AshGraphql, AshJsonApi); the research explicitly did NOT produce a per-module audit of which features ash_pplan has not adopted, so 'maximum usage' headroom is inferred, not measured. This order runs the missing audit: inventory lib/ and mix.exs consumption against the catalog, quantify the gap (AshOban, AshPaperTrail, AshCloak, bulk actions, AshGraphql/JsonApi), and give every candidate an adopt receipt or a typed refusal.
